steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title so publishing can proceed.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add one CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the required pricing sheet fields before scheduling and publishing.
Invite one QA vendor so the event can be published.
Open the Schedule Event drawer from the footer schedule control.
Assert that the requested 60-minute duration is offered.
Choose the 60-minute duration while retaining the default Start now setting.
Confirm the schedule drawer displays the calculated end-time summary.
Verify the footer schedule summary shows the selected duration.
Publish the configured event and confirm the publication flow.
Confirm the browser reached the published project page.
Verify the published Project Details page exposes the bidding end field.
Ensure publication and the resulting project page show no application error.
